snippet.title: Stuck Together - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist & Demo on Steam:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295360?utm_source=trailer

A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner. Failure is always one slip away. Will you reach your destiny beyond the attic?
